name: ChronoBox
source:
Nayuta was one of many students who attended “EDEN” on a small solitary island called “Angel Island”. The enjoyable time that he spent together with his friends was put to an end by a sole black box and a “girl in black”.

Surely, it will be all right. It’s best to keep forgetting the past which should not be remembered and continuing living their lives with their angel-like friends who have gathered in EDEN. The nightmare on which the girl leads them has yet to end...

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/05/04/may-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

Beware that the three trials have exclusive content. The first trial is a prequel to the game, the second one includes [url=/c56953]Kokuchounuma Shie[/url]'s route, and the third one includes [url=/c56949]Kanami Niwaka[/url]'s route.
Those trials can be integrated to the main game (accessible in the EXTRA menu) through a special installer.
translation:
期招来那由太在一座名为“天使岛”的偏僻小岛上，就读于“EDEN”。他与朋友们共度的快乐时光，却因一个黑色箱子和一位“黑衣少女”而终结。

一定会没事的。那些不该回想的过去，还是继续遗忘为好；与聚集在EDEN、宛如天使的朋友们一起，把日子过下去就好。少女引领他们走入的噩梦，却仍未结束……

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/05/04/may-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）

请注意，三个体验版各自包含独有内容。第一个体验版是本篇的前传，第二个包含[url=/c56953]黑蝶沼志依[/url]的路线，第三个包含[url=/c56949]叶深霍[/url]的路线。
使用专用安装程序，可将这些体验版整合进本篇，之后便能从EXTRA菜单进入。
